Stays on exact domain and skips subdomain links

```elixir title="Elixir"
engine_config = "{\"allow_subdomains\":false,\"max_depth\":1,\"respect_robots_txt\":false,\"stay_on_domain\":true}"
{:ok, engine} = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config)
url = "https://example.com"
result = Crawlberg.crawl_async(engine, url)
IO.inspect(length(result.pages))
IO.inspect(result.stayed_on_domain)
```
